title: EESP/ESF: code and results for "Group recovery after trimming, and level-free flagging, in robust clusterwise regression"
description: Code, raw results and dated analysis plans for S. Orujov, Group recovery after trimming, and level-free flagging, in robust clusterwise regression (2026), submitted to Computational Statistics. The current version is in the folder v5 (see v5/README.md): ESF (exact-subsample flagging), the group-recovery step, the data generators, the TCLUST-REG drivers for FSDA under Octave, a MATLAB check of TCLUST-REG, the scripts that write every table and figure, and the raw per-data-set results of the 7,750 simulated data sets. Earlier versions of the method (EESP, v3) are kept in v3/.

creators.name: Orujov, Samir
